_note: What a case type calls the person who handles its cases. A social-domain case type says "Regisseur", an objection keeps the default "Behandelaar": the report card's handler row reads it through nextcloud-vue facts `labelPath` (facts-label-from-path), so the word is configuration and no procedure is named in code (coordinator decision 24 Oct, DqSociaalDomein). Declared here because OpenRegister stores only declared keys. caseType moves to 1.42.0 so an existing instance re-imports the schema.

handlerLabel.title: Handler label
handlerLabel.description: What this case type calls the person handling its cases ("Regisseur"). Empty keeps "Handler".
